lanes.label: The world and the children of God
Elsewhere in scripture
lanes.range: Topics in other books wired to this one

nodes.t: Fellowship, walking in the light and confessing sin
nodes.d: John declares the Word of life that he has heard, seen and touched, says God is light, and teaches that walking in the light brings cleansing by the blood of Jesus and that confessed sins are forgiven.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what John says to do when we sin?
ev: Say what John says he saw and heard
Explain what God is according to 1:5
Describe what happens when we confess sins in 1:9

nodes.d: 1 John is a letter written so that believers may have fellowship with the Father and the Son, know they have eternal life, walk in the light, love one another, and hold to the truth that Jesus is the Christ come in the flesh.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say what 1 John wants believers to know?
ev: Name the main themes: light, love, truth about Jesus, assurance
Say what John says he wrote so that in 5:13

nodes.t: Our advocate and keeping his commandments
nodes.d: John writes that we may not sin, but if anyone sins we have an advocate, Jesus Christ the righteous, the propitiation for our sins and the whole world, and that knowing him is shown by keeping his commandments.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say who our advocate is and how we know we know him?
ev: Name what Jesus is called in 2:1-2
Say how we know that we know him

nodes.t: The old and new commandment: light and hatred
nodes.d: John says the commandment to love is old and yet new because the true light shines, and that hating a brother means walking in darkness while loving a brother abides in the light.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain how John connects loving a brother with being in the light?
ev: Contrast loving and hating a brother in light and darkness
Say who John addresses in 2:12-14

nodes.t: Not loving the world, and antichrists
nodes.d: John tells believers not to love the world, since its lust of the flesh, lust of the eyes and pride of life pass away, and warns of many antichrists who went out from them, while the anointing from the Holy One teaches them.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what John says about the world and about those who deny the Son?
ev: List what John says is in the world
Say who John calls antichrist in 2:22
Describe what he says about those who left in 2:19

nodes.t: Abiding in him and being children of God
nodes.d: John urges abiding in Christ with confidence at his appearing, says we are now sons of God and shall be like him, and that Christ appeared to take away sins and destroy the works of the devil.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain what John says about being God's children now and later?
ev: Say what we shall be when he appears
Explain why the Son of God was manifested according to 3:8
Contrast the children of God with the children of the devil

nodes.t: Love in deed and truth, assurance and the commandment
nodes.d: John says love is the message from the beginning, unlike Cain who killed his brother, that Christ laid down his life for us so we ought to love in deed and truth, and that God is greater than a condemning heart.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say what John means by loving not in word only but in deed and in truth?
ev: Say how John contrasts Cain with the love Christ showed
Explain what loving in deed and truth means in 3:17-18
State the commandment in 3:23

nodes.d: John tells believers to test every spirit, says the spirit of God confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh, and says those in them have overcome because greater is he that is in them than he that is in the world.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say how John tells us to test what teachers say?
ev: Say how to test a spirit according to 4:2-3
Explain why believers have overcome in 4:4

nodes.d: John says love is of God and God is love, shown when God sent his only Son as propitiation, that we love because he first loved us, and that perfect love casts out fear and one who hates a brother cannot love God.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain how John says we know that God is love?
ev: Say how God showed his love in 4:9-10
Explain 4:19
Describe what John says about loving God and hating a brother

nodes.t: Born of God, overcoming and the witness to the Son
nodes.d: John says everyone who believes Jesus is the Christ is born of God and overcomes the world through faith, and the witness of God about his Son is that God gave eternal life in the Son.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say what John says is the witness God gave about his Son?
ev: Say what overcomes the world in 5:4
State the record God gave in 5:11
Say what 5:12 says about having the Son

nodes.t: Assurance, prayer and keeping from idols
nodes.d: John says he wrote so believers may know they have eternal life, that God hears prayer according to his will, mentions sin not unto death and sin unto death, and ends by telling them to keep from idols.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} say what John wants his readers to know about eternal life and prayer?
ev: Say why John wrote this letter according to 5:13
Describe the confidence in prayer in 5:14-15
State John's last command

nodes.d: Genesis runs from creation (1:1) to the death of Joseph in Egypt (50:26): creation, the fall, the flood, Babel, and the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} outline Genesis in order, from creation to Joseph in Egypt?
ev: Name the four main sections: creation, fall and flood, Abraham, and the patriarchs through Joseph
Say where the story begins (1:1) and ends (50:26)

nodes.d: Cain murders his brother Abel after God accepts Abel's offering and not his own.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} tell what Cain did and how God responded?
ev: Retell the story, including God's question to Cain (4:9)

nodes.t: Walk in truth and love; beware of deceivers
nodes.d: The elder rejoices that the children walk in truth, repeats the commandment to love, warns of deceivers who deny Jesus Christ has come in the flesh, and says not to receive those who bring no such doctrine.
nodes.q: Can {{name}} explain why 2 John says to love and also to be careful about false teachers?
ev: Say what the commandment from the beginning is in 2JN 1:5-6
Describe the deceivers in 2JN 1:7
Say what the elder says to do about visitors without the doctrine
